new_jobs.title: Taiwan Logistics Launch Director
new_jobs.jd: **Description** **Company Introduction** Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond. We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” **Role Overview** The Director of TW Logistics Launch is an executive leadership role responsible for steering the end-to-end physical infrastructure and launch lifecycle across Taiwan. This position leads multi-site fulfillment network expansion—spanning land banking, real estate investment structuring, build-to-suit construction, advanced layout/CAD design, MEP engineering compliance, material handling equipment (MHE) automation, and operational launch readiness. Working at the strategic level, the Director orchestrates annual infrastructure planning, manages multi-million dollar CAPEX/OPEX budgets, oversees complex regulatory permitting, and leads specialized engineering/launch teams (Equipment, Construction, Automation Control, Real Estate, and Capacity Planning) to execute flawless greenfield and brownfield launches in a high-growth E-commerce ecosystem. **What You Will Do** **Strategic Infrastructure Program & Capacity Management** * Annual Infrastructure Plan & Master Strategy: Formulate and execute Taiwan’s long-term infrastructure master plan, aligning network expansion, hub/sub-hub/camp footprints, and capital allocation with corporate business projections. * Portfolio-Level Program Management: Oversee end-to-end program delivery (PMO) for multiple concurrent greenfield and brownfield site launches, managing critical path milestones, risk escalation protocols, and execution dashboards. * Network & Labor Capacity Optimization: Oversee node-level volume forecasting, capacity allocation, and manpower planning frameworks to maximize fixed overhead absorption and prevent throughput bottlenecks across Last-mile and Middle-mile operations. **Real Estate Development, Build-to-Suit & Permitting** * **Real Estate Strategy & Land Acquisition:** Lead macro-level site selection, land banking, build-to-suit (BTS) developments, forward-funding models, and complex commercial real estate lease/purchase negotiations. * **Investment Governance & Capital Allocation:** Build and defend high-stakes business cases, financial models, and underwriting proposals for C-level and institutional partners. * **Permitting & Government Relations:** Drive institutional stakeholder management to navigate local government entitlements, zoning compliances, environmental impact assessments, building permits, and fire safety certifications. **Construction Management, Engineering & Site Oversight** * Construction Execution & Contractor Oversight: Lead the complete construction delivery lifecycle—from contractor tendering and daily site supervision to quality defect resolution, structural inspections, and operational handover. * Multi-Disciplinary Engineering Governance: Direct technical execution across Civil Engineering, MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing), High-Voltage Electricity, Fire Fighting Systems, and IT Network Infrastructure. * Layout Design & CAD Management: Direct warehouse layout engineering, internal flow optimization, CAD drawings review, and spatial interface checks for greenfield and brownfield facilities. **Logistics Equipment & Automation Design** * **Strategic Procurement & Incoterms Management:** Oversee global and local procurement strategies for operation-critical MHE (conveyors, sorters, racks). Direct cross-border workflows, vendor selection, and Incoterms 2020 execution. * **Advanced Automation System Ownership:** Lead technical teams in reviewing Auto-Sorter designs, PLC controls (Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron), SCADA platforms, EPLAN schematics, and WMS/WCS system interfaces. * **Site Installation & Testing:** Direct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Integration Testing (SIT), and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) to ensure high-voltage safety and automated opertional readiness. **Budgeting, EHS & Change Leadership** * CAPEX / OPEX Financial Ownership: Own total financial responsibility for infrastructure expenditures; structure, track, and optimize multi-million dollar CAPEX and launch OPEX budgets. * Safety & Regulatory Compliance (EHS): Enforce strict local/international building regulations and internal EHS standards across all construction sites and automated facilities. * Innovative Mindset & Change Management: Drive continuous process innovation (PI), smart factory data collection, and standardized trouble-shooting guides to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous e-commerce environment. **Basic Qualifications** * Experience: 12–15+ years of progressive leadership experience in logistics real estate development, facility construction management, engineering launch programs, or industrial expansion within high-growth E-commerce, 3PL, or Retail Supply Chain sectors. * Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Electrical/Control Engineering, Real Estate, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Advanced certifications (e.g., PMP, Professional Engineer/PE, Architect license) are highly desirable. * Technical & Domain Expertise: Industrial / logistics industry domain knowledge and familiar with market. Demonstrated track record of executing greenfield and brownfield warehouse launches, incorporating AutoCAD designs, structural engineering, MEP systems, and local Taiwan building codes/permitting. (Small-scale sites with a Gross Floor Area (GFA) under 5,000 pyeong (approx. 16,500 m²) Hands-on familiarity with automated sorting systems, MHE procurement, vendor contract management, and PLC/SCADA control frameworks. Deep knowledge of end-to-end real estate expansion: site underwriting, land banking, BTS developer management, and municipal entitlements. * **Financial & Data Acumen** : Strong expertise in multi-million dollar CAPEX/OPEX budget management, ROI modeling, and value engineering. Proficiency in data-driven management, KPI tracking, and executive dashboard tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). * **Leadership & Competencies** : Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary teams (civil/automation engineers, real estate managers, PMO leads) and external stakeholders (contractors, government officials, vendors). High adaptability to dynamic environments (Familiar with Changes) with an Innovative Mindset focused on scalable supply chain infrastructure. * **Languages** : **Professional fluency in both spoken and written English and Mandarin (Chinese)** is strictly required for cross-border collaboration and local regulatory alignment.

new_jobs.jd: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for *all* .** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*** **.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. As a Product Owner at Micron Technology, Inc., you will report to the Smart Manufacturing and Artificial Intelligence organization. The team defines, drives, and delivers end-to-end smart manufacturing solutions, integrated across functions of the business. The team applies industry-leading methodologies in automation, **artificial intelligence (AI)** , and **generative AI (GenAI)** to enhance Micron’s product development, business, and administrative processes across the company. **Responsibilities And Tasks** * Work with users to capture and analyze information related to the adoption of apps for Smart Manufacturing. * Identify gaps, weaknesses, and inefficiencies in current solutions, including opportunities for AI-driven enhancements. * Define business solutions and propose projects for implementation, leveraging AI and GenAI technologies where applicable. * Lead projects and activities requiring coordination, support, and management of resources from global teams. * Use metrics and performance data to identify opportunities for improvement, including predictive analytics and intelligent decision support. * Provide domain and system expertise; collaborate with data scientists to perform data analysis and identify opportunities on early technology development and yield ramp challenges using AI/ML models. * Main initial focus of this position will be to support TD DRAM needs, which includes: 1) Deployment and drive adoption of existing FE smart-manufacturing solutions; 2) Coordinate SMAI tactical support on current top DRAM TD challenges. **Requirements** * Master's or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering. * Minimum 5 years' experience in Process Integration Engineering (PIE) or Process Equipment Engineering (PEE) department. * Possess strong domain knowledge of fab processes, experienced in yield improvement activities. * Good understanding and experience in early stage technology development * Possess strong analytical and problem solving skills. * Experience in leading and managing project. Good program or project management skills. * Excellent in communication, team work, and collaboration with other departments. * Strong passion for Data Science (DS), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Generative AI (GenAI), with a strong interest in applying these technologies to smart manufacturing and yield improvement. * Self-motivated **About Micron Technology, Inc.** We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all* . new_jobs.title: Marketing Manager
new_jobs.jd: Joining Razer will place you on a global mission to revolutionize the way the world games. Razer is **a place to do great work** , offering you the opportunity to make an impact globally while working across a global team located across 5 continents. Razer is also **a great place to work,** providing you the unique, gamer-centric experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally. **Job Responsibilities** Razer is looking for a dynamic, results-driven Marketing Manager to drive marketing strategy and execution across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau, with Taiwan as the primary focus market. Based in Taiwan and reporting to the APAC Marketing Director in Singapore Headquarters, you will be responsible for strengthening Razer's brand presence, driving consumer engagement and supporting market share growth through impactful marketing initiatives. This is a hands-on role for a marketing professional who combines strong execution capabilities with creative thinking and commercial awareness. You will work closely with APAC Marketing, local Sales teams, distributors, retailers, agencies and partners to deliver successful marketing programs across the assigned markets. **Key Responsibilities** **Market Strategy & Growth** * Develop and execute marketing plans for Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau, with Taiwan as the primary focus. * Translate APAC marketing priorities into locally relevant campaigns that drive brand awareness, market share and commercial growth. * Monitor consumer trends, competitor activities and market developments to identify growth opportunities. * Work closely with Sales and distribution partners to align marketing initiatives with business objectives. * Support annual marketing planning and recommend activities based on market opportunities and priorities. **Go-to-Market & Product Launches** * Plan and execute marketing activities for new product launches across assigned markets. * Ensure strong GTM readiness across retail, channel, PR, digital, social media and influencer touchpoints. * Localize regional and global campaigns to maximize relevance and impact in each market. * Collaborate with Sales to support product launches, promotional campaigns and channel sell-through initiatives. **Retail & Channel Marketing** * Drive Razer brand visibility and marketing execution across key retail and channel partners. * Develop and implement retail marketing programs, merchandising initiatives, promotions and consumer activations. * Work with Sales, distributors and retailers to enhance product visibility, shopper experience and sell-through. * Ensure consistent brand representation and execution across physical and online retail channels. **Integrated Marketing** * Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, PR, influencers, gaming communities, events and partnerships. * Build and maintain relationships with media, influencers, content creators and gaming communities. * Identify relevant partnerships and opportunities to strengthen Razer's presence within gaming, technology and lifestyle audiences. * Coordinate product seeding, media engagements, consumer activations, product launches and industry events. * Work with external agencies and partners to ensure timely and effective campaign execution. **Sales & E-commerce Collaboration** * Work closely with Sales to support commercial and e-commerce initiatives through relevant marketing activities. * Provide campaign, content, media and brand support for Sales-led online and offline programs. * Align marketing activities with promotional calendars and channel priorities to drive traffic, conversion and sell-through. * Maintain strong collaboration between Marketing and Sales to achieve shared business objectives. **Budget & Performance** * Manage assigned marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of resources. * Track campaign performance against established KPIs and recommend improvements. * Monitor market trends, competitive activities and campaign effectiveness. * Prepare regular marketing performance reports, market updates and campaign evaluations for APAC management. * Identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency, ROI and overall campaign impact. **Requirements** * 5–8 years of marketing experience, preferably within gaming, consumer electronics, technology or lifestyle brands. * Strong understanding of the Taiwan consumer, retail, digital and media landscape. * Experience in Hong Kong and Macau markets is an advantage. * Proven experience in integrated marketing, GTM, retail/channel marketing, PR, digital, social media, influencer marketing and events. * Hands-on experience planning and executing marketing campaigns from concept to completion. * Strong commercial awareness with an understanding of how marketing contributes to sales and business growth. * Experience working with Sales teams, distributors, retailers, agencies and external partners. * Good project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously. * Strong analytical skills and experience managing marketing budgets and campaign performance. * Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills. * Fluent in Mandarin and English, both written and spoken. * Self-motivated, resourceful and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment. * Passion for gaming, technology and the Razer brand is highly advantageous. **Pre-Requisites** Razer is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that diverse teams drive better ideas, better products, and a stronger culture. We are committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and fair workplace for every employee across all the countries we operate in. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, colour, nationality, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected under local laws. Where needed, we provide reasonable accommodations - including for disability or religious practices - to ensure every team member can perform and contribute at their best. **Are you game?**

new_jobs.title: Sr Mgr. Product Marketing

MSEE or MBA is a plus. * Understanding of power supply applications and products. * Experience in low power and medium power ACDC Aux/USB power supplies, AI Infrastructure market & Industrial power supply * Deep understanding of AI Server Power architecture and promote GaN Discrete, Power stages and isolated gate driver solutions as per system architecture * High energy, self-motivation and go-getter attitude. * Excellent written and oral communications skills. Ability to present complex concepts in a clear, concise and effective way. * Excellent interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively with teams located in multiple offices around the world. * Ability to collaborate and be effective in a fast-paced environment. * Track record of successfully launching products, generating design-wins and ultimately driving revenue growth. **Additional Information** Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier** . This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?
